proposedchanges.replace_with: Trump-Linked World Liberty Gets Conditional Trust-Bank Approval

World Liberty Financial received preliminary conditional approval in August 2026 for a national trust-bank charter, but final approval remained pending. The proposed charter would let the Trump family venture issue and safeguard its USD1 stablecoin, not take deposits or make loans. The decision drew conflict-of-interest concerns because Trump family members have a stake in the company while Trump-appointed officials oversee banking policy.

evidencebasis: The long says preliminary conditional approval was granted and final approval depended on conditions still to be met.
